dt_edits.value: Lower the speed and movement of all enemies within range for %_BUFF_EFFECT_TURN_% turn(s).
Deal heavy lightning-type physical damage to a single enemy, with a chance to paralyze them for %_STATUS_EFFECT_TURN_% turn(s). Effect spreads on water.
Increases damage dealt by Unstoppable Spear.
Decreases TP cost of Unstoppable Spear by 1.
Increases the range of Curfew by 1.
Decreases TP cost of Landing Impact by 1.
The Saintly Seven's Minister of Domestic Affairs. Public order, enforced at the point of a lance.
